SQL_STMT_U.val: UPDATE sale AS s SET s.billing_cutoff_date = ':3' WHERE s.id > 0 AND s.sales_date BETWEEN ':2' AND ':3' AND ( s.billing_customer_id = :1 ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM customer AS c WHERE (c.id = s.billing_customer_id OR c.billing_customer_id = s.billing_customer_id) );

UPDATE receipt AS r SET r.billing_cutoff_date = ':3' WHERE r.id > 0 AND r.receipt_date BETWEEN ':2' AND ':3' AND r.billing_customer_id = :1 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM customer AS c WHERE (c.id = r.billing_customer_id OR c.billing_customer_id = r.billing_customer_id) );
